derivation:
by
  simpa only [Fin.sum_univ_two] using (Matrix.mul_apply (M := A.1) (N := B.1) (i := 1) (k := 0))
explanation: Specialize the matrix multiplication formula to integer 2×2 matrices and indices 1, 0, then expand the two-term sum. Special-linear-group multiplication is definitionally matrix multiplication.
